name: Ventas por Destino
query:
select
  ro.posting_date as "Date:Date:100",
  roi.destination as "Destination:Data:120",
  count(distinct ro.name) as "Orders:Int:90",
  sum(roi.qty) as "Qty:Float:90",
  sum(roi.amount) as "Revenue:Currency:130"
from `tabRestaurant Order Item` roi
inner join `tabRestaurant Order` ro on ro.name = roi.parent
where ro.docstatus = 1
  and (%(from_date)s is null or %(from_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  and (%(to_date)s is null or %(to_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  and (%(company)s is null or %(company)s = '' or ro.company = %(company)s)
group by ro.posting_date, roi.destination
order by ro.posting_date desc
